scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && rm -f android/app/src/main/assets/public/pywots.apk && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk public/pywots.apk && echo "APK -> public/pywots.apk ($(du -h public/pywots.apk | cut -f1))"
